notes: Answered strictly from public biography (b. David Robert Jones, 8 Jan 1947, at home at 40 Stansfield Road, Brixton, London; no known rectification of the birth-certificate time). Part D skipped entirely per instructions: those questions ask about chapters of an astrology reading, which this blind arm never saw, so no valid answer exists. Key sources: family had documented schizophrenia on his mother's side; half-brother Terry Burns (10 years older, from mother's prior relationship) was schizophrenic and died by suicide in Jan 1985 -> A13='lost', B4 birth-order treated as not-eldest given Terry's seniority. A6/eyes: permanent anisocoria (different-looking eyes, actually a fixed dilated pupil from damaged eye muscle) from a 1962 fistfight with George Underwood over a girl -> A35#1 'accident'. A6/heart: 2004 onstage heart attack in Germany, emergency surgery, ended his touring career. A6/liver: fatal liver cancer, diagnosed mid-2014, terminal Nov 2015, died 10 Jan 2016 (two days after his 69th birthday and the release of Blackstar) - death itself has no A35 category so only the 2004 illness event was logged; the terminal 2014-16 arc is the single most load-bearing fact of his life and is not captured by any forced-choice option, flagged here explicitly. A31: documented cocaine-induced paranoia/psychosis and depression, roughly 1975 (LA, 'Station to Station' era) into the Berlin period -> 'extended'; no record of formal psychiatric treatment, so this is a judgment call. A24/A25/A26: he had two marriages (Angela Barnett 1970, divorced 1980; Iman 1992 until his death) - answered around the second, lasting, definitive marriage (1992, age 45, hence 'late'); the first marriage and its 1980 end are separately logged in A35. B1 was a genuine forced-choice conflict: Bowie's private persona (calculating, patient, strategic, quietly ambitious) matches opt1 on most points, but his lifelong pull toward the occult/Kabbalah/Crowley/Nietzsche matches only one clause of opt2 ('drawn to philosophy and hidden subjects') - chose opt1 as the better overall fit since opt2's 'hates show' and 'outspoken/hasty in speech' directly contradict a career built on spectacle and famously guarded interviews. A9 (grandparents' lifespans) is undocumented in mainstream biography -> 'unknown'. A36 is not meaningfully answerable: Bowie died in Jan 2016, entirely before the mid-2023 comparison window, so 'same' is a neutral placeholder, not a real report. A21/A22/A23: no record of personal gambling, inheritance, or debt distress (his major financial grievance was an exploitative 1970s management/royalty contract with Tony Defries, reflected instead in C11 as difficulty working under authority).
